toolDescription: Record each character's check result. Game time and shared rest are controlled above.
checkScheduleHint: Healthy characters check every 12 hours. Infected characters check every 12 hours or after a long rest; each recovery check starts the next 12-hour interval.
invalidState: Arcane Blight could not read the game state. Reload the game state before recording a result.
configureParty: Configure the party above to track Arcane Blight.
healingHint: Magical healing restores health without granting immunity.

expedition.title: Encounters and rival arrivals
expedition.scheduleHint: Campaign rule: Avarice after the first long rest, Auril after 24 hours in Ythryn. Confirm actual arrivals separately.
expedition.explorationHint: Only explicit exploration counts. Rest and ordinary clock advances do not trigger encounters. Tracking starts when these tools are added; earlier exploration is not reconstructed.
expedition.buildingHint: A thorough search takes 30 minutes of exploration. An unnumbered building also triggers a separate d100 check. A crossed exploration hour adds its own check.
expedition.patrolHint: After confirmed Avarice arrival, a first building search also checks the separate 20% patrol chance. Patrol losses and creature counts remain GM decisions.
expedition.avariceHint: Reminder at the end of the first shared long rest, including an already recorded rest.
expedition.aurilHint: Reminder at 24 hours from city entry (game time zero). Disable if Auril was already defeated.
expedition.waitingRest: Waiting for the first long rest
expedition.arrivalDue: Arrival is due — confirm when it happens in the story.
expedition.queueHint: Resolve checks in order. d100 accepts 1–100 (100 represents 00). Table replacements use confirmed arrival times. Confirm a past arrival before resolving affected overdue checks.
expedition.invalidState: The tools could not read campaign state. Refresh the game view; preserve any pending operation for retry.
expedition.invalidInput: Enter a whole number within the supported range.

outcomes.frostGiantPatrol: One frost giant skeleton and 1d3 winter wolves (Auril replacement).
outcomes.avaricePatrol: An Avarice patrol: a surviving group, normally five fanatics. Apply confirmed losses.

expedition.queueLimitHint: The queue holds 240 checks. If an activity would exceed this limit, resolve older checks before trying again. No time or checks are saved for a rejected activity.
